name: Ela
description: Can use traps to assist in combat, but traps cannot be placed <@ba.kw>on tiles already occupied by an enemy</>

candidates.name: GRZMOT Mine
candidates.description: Can deploy up to 1 GRZMOT Mine (Can store up to 2); the first enemy that passes the mine will trigger its effect. When retreats, immediately triggers the effect of a GRZMOT Mine from the tile this Operator was deployed on

candidates.name: GRZMOT Mine
candidates.description: Can deploy up to 2 <@ba.talpu>(+1)</> GRZMOT Mines (Can store up to 2); the first enemy that passes the mine will trigger its effect. When retreats, immediately triggers the effect of a GRZMOT Mine from the tile this Operator was deployed on

candidates.name: 'Bullseye'
candidates.description: Attacks have a 30% chance to deal 150% of ATK as Physical damage; The chance is increased to 100% when attacking a target that's affected by a GRZMOT Mine

candidates.name: 'Bullseye'
candidates.description: Attacks have a 30% chance to deal 160% <@ba.talpu>(+10%)</> of ATK as Physical damage; The chance is increased to 100% when attacking a target that's affected by a GRZMOT Mine
